verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's three stacked white bars at a strong size, so the headline is readable and dominates; but the bars span most of the canvas width, which hides much of the makeup imagery, and the words sit unevenly in their bars ('MAKEUP' and 'KIT' shifted right of centre). B shrinks the bars and type to small, weak text with large empty margins, so the headline loses impact and hardly reads at this size; its text is also off-centre in the bars, and the stack sits slightly off the canvas axis.
